title: Sorry, Bro
cn: 第 16 集 · 抱歉，兄弟
novel:
Ted's college girlfriend Karen [[returned|return]] to his life. She was [[pretentious|pretentious]], [[critical|critical]], and everyone hated her. But Ted was [[blinded|blind]] by [[nostalgia|nostalgia]].

"She's different now," Ted [[insisted|insist]]. She was not.

Karen [[complained|complain]] about everything — the apartment, the food, Ted's friends. She called Marshall's pants "[[pathetic|pathetic]]." Marshall was [[offended|offend]].

"Those are my [[favorite|favorite]] pants!" he [[protested|protest]].

Meanwhile, Barney lost his [[mojo|mojo]]. He could not pick up women. Every line [[failed|fail]]. He felt [[insecure|insecure]] and [[vulnerable|vulnerable]] for the first time.

"What's happening to me?" Barney [[whispered|whisper]].

Robin tried to [[encourage|encourage]] him. "You're just in a [[slump|slump]]. Everyone has them."

But Barney was [[convinced|convince]] he had lost his [[touch|touch]]. He tried increasingly [[desperate|desperate]] [[schemes|scheme]], all of which [[backfired|backfire]].

Ted finally [[realized|realize]] Karen had not changed. She still [[manipulated|manipulate]] him, still [[belittled|belittle]] his friends. He broke up with her.

"Sorry, bro," Barney said, patting Ted's back. "Some people never change."

"Yeah," Ted [[sighed|sigh]]. "I should have known."

That night, Barney tried one more time at the bar. A woman smiled at him. His [[confidence|confidence]] [[flickered|flicker]] back to life. Maybe his mojo was not gone — just [[resting|rest]].

pretentious.en: trying to seem more important than you are

blind.en: to make someone unable to see the truth

nostalgia.en: a warm feeling about the past

insist.en: to say firmly that something is true

complain.en: to say you are not satisfied

pathetic.en: making you feel pity or sadness

offend.en: to make someone feel upset or angry

mojo.en: a special quality that attracts people

slump.en: a period when you do badly

desperate.en: wanting something so much you try anything

manipulate.en: to control someone for your own purpose

sigh.en: to breathe out slowly showing sadness
